source_import_policy: No benchmarks, results, benchmark-work, cache, qualification, git, corpus path, filename, or input hash imports.
coordinator: specialized.catalog merges extracted specialised closures; generic PAQ and native candidates are owned by the runtime engine.

local_executable_closure.semantics: Each frame contains the original transform, backend payload, original length, and CRC32. No original-byte backend placeholder is emitted.
local_executable_closure.resource_contract: PAQ candidates declare 4.5 GB + 8 input bytes; filtered/Brotli candidates declare 1 GB + 8 input bytes. Decoder PAQ child output is file-size limited before completion.
local_executable_closure.admission: GOT, pointer, section and filter candidates call their native object/locator/field predicates, which retain embedded-carrier opportunities; no outer ECOFF magic gate is used.

recognition: Byte-only full ELF table-extent and Alpha ECOFF section-extent validation. Raster240 and fixed-star recognition live in their delegated format closures.
